<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Missing Welsh language letter templates",
 "problem_statement": "Customers cannot generate required Welsh-language correspondence for policyholders. This blocks their renewal process and violates contractual compliance obligations."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-11-03",
 "accounts_n": 1,
 "mentions_n": 5,
 "routes_n": 2,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "account_management": 1,
  "support": 4
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 2400000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 1,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
   "arr_gbp": 2400000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-01-15",
   "mentions": 5
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "063d773f85ea0ee9",
  "quote": "we need Welsh letter formats for claims and payments",
  "account": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
  "route": "account_management",
  "date": "2026-09-06T13:01:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "23a4f24463effd2b",
  "quote": "We need letters in Welsh for policyholders — it’s not just a nice-to-have, it’s tied to our renewal terms with Keelwater.",
  "account": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-10-16T09:43:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "43cbfa833ccdf747",
  "quote": "We need to generate formal correspondence in letters in Welsh for our policyholders in Wales — it’s non-negotiable for us.",
  "account": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-09-12T14:28:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "5fff98e79e155981",
  "quote": "We’re under pressure to deliver full compliance for our Welsh-speaking policyholders, which includes letters in Welsh — without them, our renewal won’t proceed.",
  "account": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-09-12T14:28:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "86188cd4c15e1eaf",
  "quote": "We need letters in Welsh for policyholders — it’s not just a nice-to-have, it’s tied to our renewal terms with Keelwater.",
  "account": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-10-16T09:43:00+00:00"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{"body_md": "## Problem

Hollinbrook Home Insurance cannot generate the Welsh-language correspondence its policyholders require, which blocks its renewal process and breaches contractual compliance obligations. The account has raised this 5 times across 2 routes [i:063d773f85ea0ee9][i:23a4f24463effd2b][i:43cbfa833ccdf747][i:5fff98e79e155981][i:86188cd4c15e1eaf].

## Who is affected

- Hollinbrook Home Insurance, an account with £2400000.0 in ARR and a renewal date of 2027-01-15, is the only account raising this need [i:23a4f24463effd2b].
- The account's Welsh-speaking policyholders, who need formal claims and payment correspondence in Welsh [i:063d773f85ea0ee9].
- The account's renewal with Keelwater, which the account states will not proceed without Welsh letters [i:5fff98e79e155981].

## Evidence

- The account asked for Welsh letter formats for claims and payments via account management [i:063d773f85ea0ee9].
- The account said it needs to generate formal correspondence in letters in Welsh for its policyholders in Wales and called it non-negotiable [i:43cbfa833ccdf747].
- The account said it is under pressure to deliver full compliance for its Welsh-speaking policyholders, including letters in Welsh, and that without them its renewal will not proceed [i:5fff98e79e155981].
- The account said Welsh letters are tied to its renewal terms with Keelwater and are not just a nice-to-have [i:23a4f24463effd2b][i:86188cd4c15e1eaf].
- Of the 5 mentions, 4 came through support and 1 through account management [i:063d773f85ea0ee9][i:23a4f24463effd2b][i:43cbfa833ccdf747][i:5fff98e79e155981][i:86188cd4c15e1eaf].

## Why now

- The account renews on 2027-01-15, and it states the renewal will not proceed without Welsh letters [i:5fff98e79e155981].
- The need has been raised repeatedly, from 2026-09-06 through 2026-10-16, and remains unresolved [i:063d773f85ea0ee9][i:23a4f24463effd2b][i:43cbfa833ccdf747][i:5fff98e79e155981][i:86188cd4c15e1eaf].
- The account frames Welsh letters as a contractual compliance obligation tied to its renewal terms with Keelwater, not a preference [i:23a4f24463effd2b][i:86188cd4c15e1eaf].", "citations": ["063d773f85ea0ee9", "23a4f24463effd2b", "43cbfa833ccdf747", "5fff98e79e155981", "86188cd4c15e1eaf"]}
